title: Barbiana Liu — the photo pixelates when you look away
note: The cut-out portrait is drawn into a 2D canvas (3072×4096 backing, about 330×490 on screen). Left alone, it falls apart into big square pixels (about 16px blocks) like a censored image. Move the pointer onto it and it snaps sharp, and a thin yellow (#FFFF66) frame appears around her face with a small tag on top reading "@designbarbiana", like a face-detection box on a phone camera. Move away and the mosaic returns within a second. Worth reusing: attention as the trigger. The image rewards hovering instead of a trail or scroll, and the detection box is a cheap, witty way to label a person or object.
